text: Iran's Oil Industry Pension Fund is tied to the Ministry of Petroleum: its former chairman describes the fund as a Petroleum Ministry subsidiary; Iran's oil minister chairs the fund's board of trustees, and in September 2024 he appointed the fund's chief and the members of its presiding board.
short: The Oil Industry Pension Fund sits under Iran's Petroleum Ministry: the minister chairs its trustees and appoints its board.

source.name: Asr-e Naft (relaying Miz Naft): استعفای اعضای هیئت‌رئیسه صندوق‌های بازنشستگی نفت (resignation of the oil pension funds' presiding board members)
source.quote: اعضای هیئت‌رئیسه صندوق‌های بازنشستگی، پس‌انداز و رفاه کارکنان صنعت نفت با ارسال نامه‌ای به محسن پاک‌نژاد، وزیر نفت و رئیس هیئت امنای صندوق‌ها
source.note: Translation: 'The members of the presiding board of the oil industry employees' pension, savings and welfare funds, by letter to Mohsen Paknezhad — the Minister of Petroleum and chairman of the funds' board of trustees — ...' (the board resigned over the unresolved management situation at the Khalij Fars holding). Published 27 Tir 1405 (18 July 2026).

additionalSources.name: ana.ir (Azad News Agency): Iran's Oil Industry Pension Fund Implementing 19 Projects
additionalSources.quote: The Oil Industry Pension Fund is a Petroleum Ministry subsidiary, dependent on neither the government nor the state budget
additionalSources.note: Report of then-chairman Abdol Hossein Bayat's speech at the opening of the 15th Iran Petrochemical Forum, Tehran.

additionalSources.name: EnergyPress: با اعضای جدید صندوق بازنشستگی نفت آشنا شوید (meet the oil pension fund's new members)
additionalSources.quote: محسن پاک‌نژاد، وزیر نفت با عبدالحسین بیات در صندوق بازنشستگی نفت خداحافظی کرد. پاک‌نژاد همچنین در احکامی جداگانه رئیس صندوق و اعضای اصلی و علی‌البدل هیئت‌رئیسه صندوق‌های بازنشستگی صنعت نفت را منصوب کرد.
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'Mohsen Paknezhad, the Minister of Petroleum, bade farewell to Abdol Hossein Bayat at the Oil Industry Pension Fund. Paknezhad also appointed, in separate orders, the fund's chief and the principal and substitute members of the oil industry pension funds' presiding board.' Published 19 Shahrivar 1403 (9 September 2024), news code 20915.
